system.description:
At 1st level, you establish a particularly strong bond with a Spirit Guide.
Your guide is not an animal companion or ordinary summoned creature. It is a spiritual presence connected directly to you. It may occasionally become visible or audible for narrative purposes, but unless an ability states otherwise it:
• does not occupy a space;
• cannot make attacks;
• cannot independently manipulate physical objects;
• cannot be targeted or damaged;
• does not provide flanking;
• cannot scout independently of you; and
• cannot use actions of its own.
Select one of the following Spirit Guides: Ancestor, Beast, Elemental, Land or Veil.
Your Spirit Guide grants a specialist skill, a permanent Spirit Boon and a unique manifestation when you use Manifest Spirit.
The exact appearance and personality of the spirit are yours to determine.

Use to choose: the guide arrives as its own ability with its specialist skill and Spirit Boon; Manifest Spirit reads it for the manifestation.
